contract.name: Reservation Contract Winter 2026/27 (rates 1 Nov 2026 – 31 Mar 2027)
contract.tax_note: All quoted rates include any applicable tax in force at the time of signature of this agreement; an increase of any applicable indirect tax after signing (or a new tax, levy or charge) is added as applicable by law.
contract.child_policy_text: Child between 6 – 11.99 y: 50% of the per person rate including extra bed on the booked basis (extra bed is included in the child supplement). Child below 6 y: FOC (sharing parents' accommodation). Children above 12 years are considered adults.
contract.cancellation_text: 30 days or more: No cancellation fee. 29 – 21 days prior to arrival: 75% cancellation fee. 20 – 0 days prior to arrival: 100% cancellation fee.
contract.payment_text: Group reservations (minimum 8 rooms) require an advance payment within 10 days of reservation. The hotel cannot guarantee retention without the specified payment.
contract.terms_text: Rates are subject to changes with government tax policy. Twin rooms are limited and subject to availability. Please mention the applicable special rate at the time of reservation; special rates are not valid for existing reservations or re-booking. The resort reserves the right to end the special offer within 3 working days. All reservations must be sent to the designated reservation e-mail IDs provided, unless otherwise specified. The agency cannot assign or grant any rights in this contract to third parties without written consent from the hotel. Non-distribution to other non-retail travel agencies (Spain reserved for the hotel / BGH). These rates are not valid until the signature of the contract.
contract.notes: Base meal plan Half Board, all markets, per room. BB = HB − USD 5 per person; FB = HB + lunch USD 20 per person. Room supplements per room per night over Heritage: Colonial priced in its own rows; Vintage USD 50; Tropical Garden Studios USD 160; Suites USD 180. CHECK WITH THE HOTEL: the agreement duration reads 01.11.2026 to 30.04.2027, but the season table runs 01 Nov 2026 to 31 Mar 2027 — April 2027 has no rates (plan entered to 31 Mar 2027). Rooms: Heritage 51, Colonial 15, Vintage 12, Tropical Garden Studios 5, Suites 3. Maximum occupancy: Heritage 2AD / 2AD+1CH; Colonial, Vintage, Tropical Garden Studios 2AD / 3AD / 3AD+1CH / 2AD+2CH. Contacts: general line +94 772 105 158; Front Office Manager +94 763 686 839, reservations.suisse@kandyhotels.lk; reservations +94 772 387 777 (the second e-mail is printed "reservations.suisse@kandyhohotels.lk" — likely a typo); corporate +94 117 765 555 / +94 779 910 395.
